scientific_integrity: The full joint limit and covariance identities have an analytic proof. Finite numerical checks only corroborate; no numerical experiment is treated as a universal proof.
scientific_limitations: Fixed number of sampled points as simplex dimension tends to infinity; uniform Euclidean-volume sampling and full-logarithm Hilbert cross-ratio normalization. The established Galambos copula and deterministic Hilbert-simplex variation norm are prior work. Unexamined extreme-value literature could contain equivalent formulations; historical priority and independent validation are not certified.
title: Universal one-third correlation in the joint Hilbert-distance fluctuations of random simplex points
